data.camera: medium shot, sitting at cafe table holding warm teacup
data.description: 【三笠 · 常服咖啡店】墙内市镇的咖啡店里，三笠难得穿着白色连衣裙和开衫坐在窗边，红围巾搭在膝头，端着一杯热饮望着窗外的人流——「偶尔……这样安静地坐着，也不坏。」
data.promptProse: Mikasa sits beside the town cafe window in a plain white dress and soft knit cardigan, red scarf resting across her knees as she holds a warm teacup. She watches the passing people outside in the medium view. The table edge projects forward while the window opens onto the street beyond. Soft daylight catches the cup steam and scarf texture, leaving the interior chair and boots quietly shaded.
data.title: 三笠 · 常服咖啡店
